motion.name: motion-fast

motion.name: motion-state
motion.purpose: Source --motion-state: shared state transitions, menu arrivals and local review/edit entry.

motion.name: motion-overlay
motion.purpose: Source --motion-overlay: money-dialog and scrim arrivals.

motion.name: motion-theme
motion.purpose: Source --motion-theme: targeted theme background, border and color continuity.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Source --ease-settle: naturally decelerating dialog/menu/step arrivals, without bounce.

motion.name: ease-feedback
motion.purpose: Source --ease-feedback: control/theme feedback and tooltip arrival.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.value: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
motion.purpose: Canvas, panels, logo wordmark and targeted semantic surfaces/text settle between existing theme roles; no page-sized filter or privacy fade.

motion.name: shared-control-transition
motion.value: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), translate 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
motion.purpose: Current unlayered Button/Input/Select-trigger rules override base utility transitions. Runs only when motion is permitted.

motion.name: enabled-button-press
motion.purpose: Enabled shared Buttons only, excluding disabled/aria-disabled controls. Not a hover lift or an Input/Select-trigger press rule; absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: navigation-transition
motion.value: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), translate 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
motion.purpose: Rail state feedback and shorter individual translate; reduced motion removes transitions and the shared Button press.

motion.name: dialog-scrim-in
motion.purpose: Open scrim opacity 0 → 1; backdrop blur remains constant at 5px.

motion.name: dialog-scrim-out
motion.purpose: Closed scrim fades from its captured rendered opacity to 0; pointer events are disabled during exit.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Fresh entry: opacity 0 → 1, translate 0 12px → 0 0, scale 0.985 → 1. An interrupted exit resumes from its captured frame. Individual properties preserve the centered transform.

motion.name: dialog-out
motion.purpose: Fade captured opacity to 0, move 6px farther down from captured translation, multiply captured scale by 0.99. No fully-open restart; closing content does not intercept pointer events.

motion.name: menu-in
motion.purpose: Fresh DropdownMenu/Select entry: opacity 0 → 1, scale 0.98 → 1, vertical -4px (below) or +4px (above) to zero. Interrupted exits resume from their captured frame; retain the actual Radix transform origin.

motion.name: menu-out
motion.purpose: Fade captured opacity to 0, preserve captured translation, and multiply captured scale by 0.985; closing menu content does not intercept pointer events.

motion.name: tooltip-in
motion.purpose: Fresh delayed/instant-open tooltip opacity 0 → 1, or from a captured interrupted exit, independent of the existing 200ms provider delay.

motion.name: tooltip-out
motion.purpose: Closed tooltip fades from its captured rendered opacity to 0.

motion.name: review-in
motion.purpose: Local review opacity 0.6 → 1 and translate 8px 0 → 0 0, while preserving heading focus and the draft.

motion.name: edit-in
motion.purpose: Returning form only (data-entry=back): opacity 0.6 → 1, translate -8px 0 → 0 0. Initial form entry adds no duplicate step animation.

motion.name: skeleton-breathe
motion.purpose: Decorative skeleton breathing, with opacity 0.45 at 50%; reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: scroll-behavior
motion.purpose: Section scrolling only. Reduced motion disables smooth scrolling, transitions and animations immediately, preserving state/focus. No money tween, privacy fade, page-load choreography, animated blur or persistent will-change. Static previews do not emulate portals or run entrance animations.

narrative.overview:
Icy-blue glass sits over a diffuse navy wash. Rounded panels and softly raised controls make the interface tactile without competing with balances, field labels, or review details. The approved reference supplies the material character, not a different banking product or a permanent page topology.

Workhorse system typography, purposeful Lucide icons, and restrained navy accents keep task completion ahead of decoration. Light and dark themes share the same material roles. Simulation notices, unavailable information, and disabled final actions remain legible parts of the composition rather than being disguised as successful financial activity.
keyCharacteristics: Icy-blue glass and a diffuse navy backdrop.
Soft offset depth, rounded panels, and selectively raised controls.
Workhorse UI type with tabular figures and wrapping long values.
Named desktop icons with real tooltips, visible mobile labels, and clear focus.
Equivalent light/dark roles and honest unavailable states.

rules.name: The Theme Roles Rule
rules.body: Use semantic CSS properties in both themes; do not freeze light surfaces or white primary-action text into a theme-aware control. The approved logo icon is a fixed-color asset exception; its wordmark follows ink, not on-navy action text.

rules.name: The Readable Figures Rule
rules.body: Keep tabular numerals, explicit currency labels, and wrapping long values. Format money through the existing minor-unit presentation helpers; do not visually truncate an amount or account ID to preserve a card silhouette.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use ambient shadows for panels and paired soft offsets for raised controls; bounded task overlays may settle through transform/opacity, not ornamental hover lift or animated blur.

dos: Do use semantic theme roles for glass, ink, navy actions, and their dark counterparts.
Do preserve soft offset depth, rounded panels, and selectively raised controls.
Do use the native UI sans stack, tabular figures, explicit currencies, and wrapping long values.
Do give desktop icon navigation accessible names and real tooltips; retain visible mobile and quick-action labels.
Do reuse the shared shadcn/Radix controls, visible focus, associated errors, and one loading announcement per busy region.
Do preserve dialog drafts, focus return, viewport overflow, and fixed-navigation clearance.
Do honor reduced motion, reduced transparency, and forced-colors treatments.
Do reuse the approved CocoWallet vector: fixed icon colors, ink-following wordmark, and a preserved accessible name.
Do preserve focus and drafts through bounded overlay/step motion, with immediate state changes under reduced motion.
Do keep simulation, preview, inspect-only, and unavailable states plain and visible.
donts: Don't freeze light-theme colors into theme-aware controls or use white text on the dark theme's pale primary fill.
Don't replace the icy glass world with warm cream, an unapproved display font, or a different visual identity.
Don't add hard stacked shadows, ornamental lift animations, or hover-only labels on mobile.
Don't tween financial values or privacy masking, animate blur/full-page filters, or add page-load choreography and persistent `will-change`.
Don't truncate monetary values or account IDs to preserve panel geometry.
Don't restore stale native utility-select or inline-workspace examples that misrepresent the current shared controls.
Don't depict disconnected services as completed money movement, stored preview balances, real payment cards, or live exchange rates.
Don't turn the wallet's surface-specific column arrangement into a global layout prohibition.
